macro.text: Brent 113.05 (+2.0%), WTI 103.85 (+1.8%) after Iran claimed four tankers struck mines in Hormuz, with strike fears growing after the U.S. midterms.
10-year 4.989% (-5.6 bp), 30-year 5.329% (-3.2 bp), 2-year near 4.75%; easing long yields help real estate and utilities.
Fed: ~84% odds of a Dec 9 hike after Wednesday's 10-2 hold; LSEG shows >50 bp of hikes priced by mid-2027.
BOJ held rates as underlying inflation met 2% for the first time since 2013; euro zone Q3 GDP +0.4%, France -0.1%.
Binance halted withdrawals after a record $6.3B hack; FBI and Secret Service are working with it.

briefs.read: Risk-off in tech, risk-on in defensives and energy. QQQ -2.57% premarket, SPY -1.05%, IWM -0.60%: selling is concentrated in chips after Intel's guide (-25%) and Amazon's cash burn (-7%). VIX 18.68, 10-yr ~4.99% (-5.6 bp), Brent $113 (+2%) on Iran's Hormuz mine claim. No red U.S. events today; let the first 5-15 minutes set the range before taking a setup.

readthrough.note: Intel's Q4 guide drives the biggest chip-equipment and memory gaps (LRCX, AMAT, KLAC, ASML, SKHY), while Amazon's cash burn hits AI servers and neoclouds (DELL -12%, NBIS, CRWV).

briefs.scenario: Scenario in play: if hyperscalers raise capex while their cash flow weakens (Amazon overnight), the report expects MU, SKHY, VRT, GEV, AVGO, CRWV to lead; premarket they are falling with Amazon instead.

earnings.result: Adj. EPS $0.52 vs $0.40; revenue $16.5B vs $16.48B. Q4 guide $15-16B vs $17.08B, adj. EPS $0.25 vs $0.44, 38% margin; cash burn this year.
earnings.meaning: Memory costs and supply limits squeeze chip buyers; chip equipment and Asian memory fell in sympathy (SK Hynix -7.1%, ASML -5%).

earnings.result: Revenue $201.9B vs ~$202.2B; EPS $1.89 (GAAP) vs ~$1.97; AWS +39% to $46.0B, backlog $578B; Q3 capex $77.3B, 2027 'meaningfully more'; trailing FCF -$42.4B. (Amazon is a major Anthropic investor; I'm built by Anthropic.)
earnings.meaning: Suppliers get a bigger 2027 order book, but the market is selling hyperscaler cash burn.

earnings.result: Warned daily active unique visitors (~130M) could fall a low double-digit % in Q4 as Google search referrals drop.
earnings.meaning: AI search is eating referral traffic; Piper calls for a reset in expectations.

earnings.meaning: War-driven refining margins keep lifting the majors.

earnings.result: Adj. EPS $3.82 vs $3.74; revenue $17.4B vs $17.36B; 2026 adj. EPS raised to $13.95-13.99, in line.
earnings.meaning: The raise was expected, so no pop.

earnings.result: Net sales $5.37B vs $5.34B; diluted (GAAP) EPS $0.94 vs $0.93 adj. consensus; adj. EPS growth outlook lifted to 5-7%.
earnings.meaning: Staples are where money hides today.

earnings.result: Adj. EPS $0.42 vs $0.21; revenue $809M vs $786M; FY adj. EPS raised to ~$2.20.
earnings.meaning: Turnaround beat in a weak tape.

briefs.flowNote: Money is leaving chips and AI hardware for defensives, health care and energy. Semiconductors (SMH -5.24%), high-growth tech (ARKK -4.11%) and tech (XLK -3.67%) fund the move after Intel's guide and Amazon's cash burn; consumer discretionary (XLY -1.33%) and communication (Reddit, Pinterest) lag. Staples (XLP +2.29%, Colgate), health care (XLV +1.71%, Regeneron, AstraZeneca, Lilly) and energy (XLE +1.46%, Exxon and Chevron beats, Brent $113) lead; easing long yields help real estate and utilities.

AWS +39% and $578B backlog vs EPS miss and -$42.4B trailing FCF.
